specFidelityNotes: Uncommitted diff vs origin/main (ef3ea591) for MMU-11 (#559). Intent: Action Cards/Scoring sole write owner for decision tables; reroute legacy recommendation create-via-API; registry/docs agree; preserve refresh→persist and GET empty-shop behavior. Route recommendations.py removes inline _refresh_recommendations + RecommendationsRepo.create; delegates to action_cards.persist_legacy_recommendations on empty list. New legacy_recommendations.py holds the lifted persist logic (behavior-compatible). action_cards __init__ exports persist_legacy_recommendations on public __all__; MODULE.md + api/MODULE.md + MODULES.md + ownership-registry.yml updated consistently for Action Cards/Scoring write ownership. Contract tests (test_mmu11_decision_persistence_ownership.py) assert no RecommendationsRepo import or repo.create in API route, delegation on empty GET, registry notes, public facade export, and refresh→persist_scoring_result on owning module. Only RecommendationsRepo.create callsites for recommendations table are now in services/action_cards/legacy_recommendations.py. PRD user story 28 and technical clarification (route legacy writes through owner) satisfied.

convention_notes.note: legacy_recommendations.py imports RecommendationsRepo from repositories.repos; MODULE.md Dependencies lists ActionCardsRepo but not RecommendationsRepo for the retained legacy table path. Public API and Key behaviors document persist_legacy_recommendations; optional follow-up to list RecommendationsRepo under Dependencies.

GET /v1/recommendations remains a read route that triggers owner persist on empty shop (preserved side-effect); documented as delegate to action_cards, not direct repo.create — matches PRD reroute-not-remove intent.
